reuse.why: The change reuses category selection, amount conversion, batching and undo abstractions, but implements tag recognition instead of using the existing shared tag helpers.

duplication.why: Bulk eligibility remains centralized, but the inline #fixed regex duplicates tag recognition already implemented in shared/tags.ts.

placement.why: Category eligibility and budget calculations stay in server budget actions, with method registration in the existing app layer.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested bulk budget actions, their registration and related tests.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility function keeps future exclusions manageable, although tag recognition should use the established shared definition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts uses an inline #fixed regex instead of the tag helpers in packages/loot-core/src/shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline #fixed predicate reshapes existing shared tag recognition into a specialized regex rather than sharing its definition.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains fixed-group and saved-template exclusion branches without adding helper parameters; its fixed-group predicate bypasses shared tag recognition.
